intent: Compare the share of respondents supporting legalization with the share opposing it across the inner and outer arcs.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the support share in the inner arc with the opposition share in the outer arc

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in Inner arc.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in Outer arc.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Support legalization is 52% in the inner arc, compared with 45% opposition in the outer arc.
accept: Inner arc support share is 52% and outer arc opposition share is 45%, presented as a cross-arc comparison.
The clip compares 52% support in the inner arc against 45% opposition in the outer arc.
reject: Only one arc's share is shown without the other.
The two shares are added or combined into a single total.
The comparison is between entities within the same arc rather than across inner and outer arcs.

optional_valid: Showing the inner arc as a partial ring at 52% and the outer arc at 45% with labels identifying support and opposition.
unsupported_to_avoid: Deriving a remainder or complement for either arc, since the intent only asks to compare the two stated shares.
Ranking sectors within a single arc.
Treating the inner and outer arc shares as parts of one combined whole.
review_notes: The intent explicitly asks for a cross-arc comparison of support versus opposition, so a single cross_panel_compare unit captures the required analytical content.
No remainder unit is required because the intent does not ask for the unspecified complement of either arc.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
